# Red Teaming Toolkit (fixture)

A curated collection of tools for red team operations, grouped by phase.

This fixture is synthetic: every entry below is invented and points at
`example.test`. It models the upstream README's categorized
`- [Tool](url) - description` list style.

## Reconnaissance

- [ReconHarvester](https://example.test/rtt/recon-harvester) - subdomain and DNS reconnaissance
- [PortSweep](https://example.test/rtt/portsweep) - fast TCP port scanner

## Exploitation

- [ExploitForge](https://example.test/rtt/exploit-forge) - exploit development framework
- [PayloadSmith](https://example.test/rtt/payloadsmith) - payload generation; see [the formats page](https://example.test/rtt/payloadsmith/formats) for details

## Persistence

- [GhostHook](http://example.test/rtt/ghosthook) - persistence over a legacy HTTP channel
- SchedTasker - scheduled-task persistence helper, homepage to be announced
- [ReconHarvester NG](https://example.test/rtt/recon-harvester/) - trailing-slash duplicate of the reconnaissance entry above
